fields.name: Microsoft Azure
fields.description: We are seeking a motivated, tech-savvy Junior Full-Stack Developer (or OJT Intern) to join our engineering team. In this role, you will help build, maintain, and scale user-friendly web applications. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design database architectures, develop robust APIs, and implement real-time features.The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building projects from scratch using the Python/Django ecosystem, understands real-time communication protocols, and is eager to solve real-world problems.Key ResponsibilitiesBackend Development: Design, develop, and maintain server-side logic and RESTful APIs using Python and Django REST Framework.  Database & Optimization: Write clean, efficient SQL queries, manage database schemas in PostgreSQL, and utilize Redis for caching or message broking.  Real-Time Features: Implement and maintain real-time capabilities (like chat systems or live notifications) using WebSockets and Django Channels.  Frontend Integration: Build responsive, cross-platform user interfaces using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap 5.  Cloud & DevOps Support: Assist with cloud storage configurations (such as DigitalOcean or Cloudinary) and support application deployment pipelines.  Collaboration & Documentation: Document code, write technical specifications, and utilize Git for team version control.  Required Skills & QualificationsEducation: Currently pursuing or a recent graduate of a Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.  Core Programming: Strong foundational knowledge of Python and JavaScript.  Framework Proficiency: Hands-on project experience with Django 4.x and building RESTful APIs.  Databases: Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and key-value stores (Redis).  Tools & Cloud: Familiarity with Git, third-party API integration, and cloud platforms like Render or DigitalOcean.  Soft Skills: A strong drive to learn, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively on a team.
